subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission window & net-term exchange plan
messages:
From: Janelle Park <janelle.park@cobaltworks.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@cobaltworks.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: New vendor setup + payment window question

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the warm intro. We're getting our vendor intake completed on our side for CobaltWorks' engagement with Redwood. A couple quick points:

- Can you confirm the preferred invoice submission window (cutoff day/time) so our AP team can schedule batch sends?
- We're set up to accept Net30 by default, but we also offer a 1.5% early-pay discount if Redwood can remit within 10 business days. Would Redwood consider an early-pay enrollment for the first 3 invoices while we ramp?

I attached our vendor form and a sample PO layout for your AP team to review.

Attachments: CobaltWorks_Vendor_Form.pdf (application), CobaltWorks_PO_Example.xlsx (PO sample)

Best,
Janelle Park
Finance Operations Manager
CobaltWorks
janelle.park@cobaltworks.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Janelle Park <janelle.park@cobaltworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup + payment window question

Hi Janelle — thanks, and welcome.

Quick answers up front:
- Our standard invoice processing window closes EOD (PST) on the first business day after invoice receipt for the weekly AP run. For budgeting we usually communicate a target payment date (Net30/45/60) in our PO acknowledgement.
- We do have an early-pay program but it’s managed by Finance for approvals; I can route this request. Marissa is cc'd — Marissa, can we evaluate the 1.5% early-pay incentive for the first three invoices and confirm whether AP can process on a 10-business-day glide?

Next steps:
1) I’ll kick off vendor onboarding internally and confirm the final vendor ID.
2) Marissa — if approved, can AP include a note on our PO template to flag early-pay eligible invoices so your team can detect them automatically?
3) Janelle — a quick clarification: do your invoices include a PO number field (column A in the sample) and a clear remittance address? If so we should be able to ingest without changes.

Thanks — I’ll follow up once I have the vendor ID and any approval from Finance.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Janelle Park <janelle.park@cobaltworks.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 14:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup + payment window question

Hi all — looping in AP details.

Marissa here (Finance ops). A few operational notes so we align:

- Standard cadence: invoice received by 5pm PT on Monday -> processed in the Tuesday batch -> payment run in 7 business days (this maps roughly to our Net terms calendar). We often translate that to Net30/45/60 depending on contract.
- Early-pay requests: Finance evaluates discounts >1% on a case-by-case basis. For a 1.5% early-pay for the first 3 invoices I need: vendor tax ID, bank remit details (ACH), and confirmation that the invoice will be flagged with PO# + "EARLYPAY-OPTIN" in the invoice notes so our ingestion rules can auto-detect.
- If CobaltWorks wants a deterministic payment date (e.g., guaranteed on X date), we typically reserve that for partners on a committed billing plan (reserved capacity customers) — otherwise we can commit to the evaluation and a one-off early-pay enrollment.

Dylan from AP: can you confirm how quickly we can turn the first three invoices if we get the info today?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Marissa / Vivek — AP here.

We can expedite the first three invoices on a 10-business-day schedule provided we receive the vendor setup payload today (vendor form + ACH details + tax ID) and CobaltWorks uses the PO# + "EARLYPAY-OPTIN" tag in the invoice notes. Once ingested, the system marks them for priority in the next processing cycle and we can clear payment in 10 business days from the validated receipt date.

Janelle — two practical items for us to avoid delays:
- Ensure the invoice filename contains the PO number (e.g., PO-123456_invoice.pdf) so our parser doesn't split lines incorrectly.
- Remittance: confirm ACH routing + account + beneficiary name in the vendor form.

If you send the completed form back I’ll do a manual ingest for the first two invoices to prove out the workflow, then we can automate.

Thanks,
